text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. envoy for Western Sahara James Baker attends a dinner given by Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali.
- Benin withdraws its support from the Algeria-backed Polisario front.
- U.N. envoy James Baker's tour in North Africa attracts Algeria's fire on Morocco and United Nations.
- Morocco prepares calendar of elections which are expected to take place in the second half of 1997.
- U.S. administration expresses its support for Morocco's efforts to solve the Western Sahara dispute.
- A Canadian firm is expected to start oil and gas drilling in northern Morocco from June.
- The government of PM Abdellatif Filali prepares 1997/98 draft budget seen as 'technocrats' budget'.
- U.N. envoy meets King Hassan and leaders of political parties, including the opposition.
